summary: Phase 5 Damma online multiplayer — BACKEND 100% PASS (3/3 active tests + 1 long-running skipped), FRONTEND has 1 CRITICAL routing bug. Backend (/app/backend/tests/test_damma_online.py): (1) Single-user POST /api/damma/queue/join with num_players=4 → /queue/status returns {matched:false} for ~24s then flips to {matched:true, rid:...}; the created room has 1 human + 3 bots, phase='playing', all tile_counts populated. (2) WebSocket /api/damma/ws/{rid}?user_id=... first message is {type:'room', room:{num_players:4, phase:'playing'}}, second is {type:'state', hand:[5 tiles], board:[], left_end:null, right_end:null}. Chat broadcast echoes back with from_pid matching sender slot. Illegal move ({tile_id:'9-9'}) returns {type:'error', message:'illegal move'}; play sent when NOT our turn returns 'not your turn'. After we play our first legal tile, the bot autoplay chain kicks in and we observe board growth + bot tile_counts decreasing within ~6s. (3) Disconnect-grace: close WS then reconnect after 3s — server still has us in the room and slot.is_bot is still false. Long-running bot-only-game-completes test is skipped by default (set DAMMA_TEST_LONG=1 to enable). FRONTEND (Expo web preview, 390x844 mobile viewport, logged in as testuser1): The lobby loads correctly, 'ابحث عن مباراة أونلاين (4 لاعبين)' button is visible and tappable, the searching modal with spinner + 'البحث عن مباراة' + 'موقعك: #1' + counter appears, and after ~24s the 'تم العثور على مباراة!' success modal appears with rid and a gold 'ادخل المباراة' (Enter Match) button — BUT clicking 'ادخل المباراة' navigates to /game/damma?rid={rid}&online=1 (the OLD offline screen route) instead of /game/damma-online?rid={rid} as the source code in damma-lobby.tsx:260 (router.replace({pathname:'/game/damma-online', params:{rid: matchedRid}})) says it should. The user lands on the green offline classic damma board with 'Opponent's Turn ... Thinking...' instead of the new dark online screen 'ضمنة • أونلاين'. This appears to be a stale Metro bundle OR an old binding that was not refreshed after damma-lobby.tsx was edited — the source code is correct, the runtime is wrong. NOTE: the spec asks for AUTO-navigate after match found; the current code instead shows a 'Match Found' modal and waits for the user to tap a button — by design (line 257 enterMatchedRoom callback). The bigger issue is that even when tapped, the navigation is wrong.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'ادخل المباراة' (Enter Match) after queue resolves navigates to /game/damma?rid={rid}&online=1 (OFFLINE classic screen) instead of /game/damma-online?rid={rid}. The new dedicated online screen at /app/frontend/app/game/damma-online.tsx never renders for the user. Source code in damma-lobby.tsx:257-261 looks correct (router.replace pathname:'/game/damma-online'), but the runtime bundle is serving an older binding. Suspect stale Metro cache OR the lobby's enterMatchedRoom callback was overridden somewhere. Repro: log in as testuser1 → /game/damma-lobby → tap 'ابحث عن مباراة أونلاين' → wait ~25s → tap 'ادخل المباراة' → URL becomes /game/damma?rid=...&online=1 instead of /game/damma-online?rid=...

issues: Spec says 'auto-navigate to /game/damma-online'; current implementation shows a 'Match Found' confirmation modal that requires the user to tap 'ادخل المباراة'. This is reasonable UX but does not match the auto-redirect requirement. Either accept the modal OR add an auto-redirect after 2-3s.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' on every navigation. Benign on web preview but spams logs. Reference: not blocking.

Repeated warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"', '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carry-over from earlier iterations; not introduced by Phase 5 but the new damma-online.tsx also uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity (lines 468-469) and textShadow* (line 461). Worth migrating in a sweep.

action_items: CRITICAL: investigate why tapping 'ادخل المباراة' in damma-lobby navigates to /game/damma?rid={rid}&online=1 instead of /game/damma-online?rid={rid}. Likely fix: clear Metro cache (rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo) or grep for ANY other place that sets router.replace('/game/damma' with online query param. The source enterMatchedRoom in damma-lobby.tsx:257-261 is correct.
OPTIONAL: convert the 'Match Found' modal into an auto-redirect (or add a 3s auto-redirect timer) so the spec's 'auto-navigate to /game/damma-online' is satisfied without requiring the user tap.
OPTIONAL: migrate damma-online.tsx shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents to the new style API (boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents) — cosmetic but reduces console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: damma_online.py is well-structured. The bot autoplay chain (_maybe_schedule_bot_turn → _play_bot_turn with cascade) is solid. One nit: _play_bot_turn at line 599 has hard-coded 1100ms think delay; consider making it configurable for tests.

damma_online.py:582 — when a player sends 'play'/'draw'/'pass' while the room is in lobby or game_over phase, the handler silently returns without an error response. Consider sending a {type:'error', message:'not playing'} so the client knows.
damma_online.py:572 — slot.ws is dereferenced with 'type: ignore'. If the WS dropped between turn check and send_json, this could raise. Wrap in try/except to be safe.
useDammaOnline.ts is clean. Reconnect backoff at line 250 (600 * 2^attempt, capped 8s) is reasonable. Good cleanup in teardownRef pattern.
damma-online.tsx:208 — gameOver = state.phase==='game_over' || !!online.endResult; correct. Score banner aggregates opponents into a single 'opp' total — reasonable for 4P display.
damma-online.tsx:153-156 — exitMatch calls online.disconnect() then router.back(). LGTM. confirmExit() shows the Alert with cancel/destructive options as required.

MINOR: damma-online.tsx imports the LOCAL engine's getPlayableSides at line 25 for client-side visual hints; that's fine since the server is authoritative — but the imported engine 'state' shape must keep matching the reconciled state. If the offline engine API drifts, online's playableSides hints will silently break.

success_rate.frontend: 60% — lobby loads + queue + match-found modal work, but the final navigation to /game/damma-online is broken in the runtime bundle

seed_data_creation: All tests use ephemeral TEST_p5_* user_ids that are auto-leaved post-test. No DB writes — queue is in-memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_damma_online.py and pass cleanly via `pytest tests/test_damma_online.py -v --asyncio-mode=auto` from /app/backend. Each test takes 25-30s because of the queue timeout-fill wait. The KEY frontend issue: the Enter-Match button in the matchmaking modal navigates to /game/damma (OFFLINE) with rid+online=1 query params instead of /game/damma-online. Likely a Metro cache stale bundle — recommend `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and re-test. The new /game/damma-online screen itself was NOT exercised end-to-end through the UI because of this routing bug, but direct navigation to /game/damma-online?rid={valid_rid} would let you verify the WS-driven board, chips, hand tray, connecting overlay, exit confirm Alert, etc.
rca_of_issue: Lobby → /game/damma-online routing bug RCA: damma-lobby.tsx:260 source code calls router.replace({pathname:'/game/damma-online', params:{rid: matchedRid}}). The runtime navigates to /game/damma?rid={rid}&online=1 (with online=1 as a query param that does not exist anywhere in the current source). Most likely cause: stale .metro-cache holding an older bundle of damma-lobby.tsx where enterMatchedRoom was: router.replace({pathname:'/game/damma', params:{rid, online:'1'}}). Mitigation: clear metro cache (`rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache`) and restart expo. If that doesn't fix it, grep for 'online: "1"' or 'online:1' across /app/frontend to find a hidden override. Confirm fix: re-run the lobby flow and ensure URL becomes /game/damma-online?rid={rid}.
